_note: Fact base for the M&M initiation, standalone basis (auto + farm) with group stakes valued separately. Every figure has a source and publication date; nothing published after 30-Sep-2026 is used (later facts sit in updates/later-facts.json).

profile.what: India's largest SUV maker by revenue market share (25.0% in Q1FY27) and the world's largest tractor maker by volume (domestic share 43.6% in FY26), plus the No.1 maker of pickups/LCVs under 3.5 tonnes (52% share). The listed parent (standalone M&M) holds the automotive and farm businesses; it also owns 25.3% of Tech Mahindra, 52.5% of M&M Financial Services, 92.45% of the EV company MEAL and stakes in ~10 other listed and unlisted group companies.

q1fy27.commodity: Auto absorbed 400-500bp of commodity inflation in Q1 (escalated after Feb-2026 with the West Asia conflict) and an ~85bp hedging loss in the last 10 days of June when commodities fell on news the war was stopping; farm 300-400bp (steel +24%, rubber +30% YTD, unhedgeable). Price increases: auto ~1.5% (spring) + 2.7% average (mid-Jul-2026); tractors ~Rs15,000 per unit (Aug).
q1fy27.guidance: Auto: Q1 is the low point; Q2 operating margin maintained or slightly better if commodities hold. Farm: temporary pressure in Q2 (commodities, festival shift to 11-Oct). FY27 (Q4FY26 call, May-2026): M&M UV growth mid-to-high teens, tractor industry mid-single digits, LCV industry high single digits. Capacity, not demand, is the constraint in SUVs.
q1fy27.capacity: Operational SUV capacity 64.5k/month at FY26 exit (56.5k ICE + 8k BEV), 68k by Sep-2026, 82k by Mar-2027 (14k of it for FY28 launches), 92k by FY28 exit (NU_IQ phase 2 at Chakan), Nagpur greenfield 20k/month by H1CY29 and another 20k ~12 months later: 2x in five years (FY26-FY31 exit).

history.event: SsangYong (Korea) put into receivership and written off; Rs3,087 cr standalone exceptional loss in FY21; Anish Shah becomes MD & CEO (Apr-2021) with a capital-allocation framework (exit loss-makers, 18% ROE hurdle)
XUV700 (Aug-2021) and Scorpio-N (Jun-2022) launches; EV business moved to MEAL with BII's investment (Jul-2022); FY23 exceptional loss Rs1,430 cr (trucks impairment net of Susten/SEL gains)
Thar Roxx (Aug-2024); INGLO EV platform with BE 6 and XEV 9e (launched Nov-2024); LMM carved out with IFC/IJF money; RBL Bank stake bought (Rs417 cr) and later sold

GST 2.0 from 22-Sep-2025 (SUVs 40% with no cess, small cars and CVs 18%, tractors 5%); SML Isuzu acquired; XEV 9S launched; record UVs 6.6 lakh and tractors 5.26 lakh; MEAL turned profitable (PAT Rs387 cr)

West Asia conflict drives 400-500bp commodity inflation; CIE stake sold; Erkunt Foundry exited; SML Mahindra's board approves buying M&M's Truck & Bus Division on a slump sale for Rs525 cr (29-Jul-2026; completion targeted in FY27; SML shares +44% in two days)

accounting: From FY23 'income from investments related to subsidiaries, associates and JVs' (dividends, interest on loans to group companies, stake-sale gains: Rs2,190 cr in FY26) is shown inside total income from operations, and 'loss from investments' (write-downs: Rs677 cr in FY26) inside expenses. We move both out (M&M.patch.js) so revenue and EBITDA are the operating business only.
e-SUVs are built by M&M and sold to MEAL at full vehicle value (Rs12,413 cr in FY26) at a ~0.4% PBIT margin: this inflates standalone revenue growth and dilutes the standalone margin as EVs grow.
Impairments of group investments recur: Rs3,087 cr (FY21), Rs1,430 cr (FY23), Rs253/848/677 cr (FY24-26); cumulative impairment Rs7,101 cr at Mar-26.
PLI incentives for EVs (Rs1,371 cr of 'government grants and incentives' in FY26 revenue, all schemes) support EV profitability; management says MEAL is EBITDA positive without PLI.
